mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_intent ( id, merchant_id, amount, currency, idempotency_key, status, provider_reference, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{merchantId}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{status}, #{providerReference}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, merchant_id, amount, currency, idempotency_key, status, provider_reference, created_at, updated_at FROM payment_intent WHERE id = #{id}
